summary: Keep the web roster visible across daemon leaf-field version skew and disclose undecodable agents without presenting an empty roster as fact

replay.detail: No daemon claim replay or persistent recovery changes. The web SDK retains the last good roster when every row of a later snapshot fails decoding.

schema.detail: Web-only SDK decoding change. Generated wire schemas and generator output are unchanged; no database migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digest changes, or coordinated member upgrade.

compatibility.detail: The SDK tolerates unrecognized leaf literals while retaining their raw values, and reports row identity failures independently. Deploy the web app without upgrading the daemon.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, pairing, or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions.
